name: Kumi Katayama

sources.note: Client-rendered shell; numeric verification uses public upstream English source.

implemented: S1/S2 Hard Knocks, S2/S3 affinity-independent per-target Down reductions, S3 Detention, and the two-owner-turn Lightning Legs state.
Base A0 Hard Knocks enhancement at every awareness rank, A1/A2/A4 knockdown effects, Highlight permanent defense decrease and three-turn damage-taken debuff.
Explicit four-star static and knockdown Attack, signature Lightning Legs critical rate, and reviewed base coefficients.
missing: A6 Wings of Guidance and fatal-damage evasion require damage prevention and owner-action scheduling. Signature crit-damage-taken has no critical-result status consumer.
English/Japanese S1 enhancement 35% and downed-foe Attack 36% differ from Korean/Chinese 30%; cap interpretation of speed-scaled debuffs also differs. These contested effects are excluded.
Dizzy/Shock accuracy and immunities; dynamic flat Attack conversion from live game stats to normalized simulator stats.
limitations: This is a partial source-based implementation, not a live-battle calibration.
sourceTier explicitly selects one of four printed coefficient columns, default 3 to match the current catalog. A3/A5 skill ranks are not multiplied again.
No weapon is assumed. characterOptions[slug].weapon accepts none, four-star, signature; refinement 0..6. staticWeaponStatsIncluded prevents double-counting passive equipment bonuses.
A6 Wings of Guidance and fatal-damage evasion require damage prevention and owner-action scheduling. Signature crit-damage-taken has no critical-result status consumer.
English/Japanese S1 enhancement 35% and downed-foe Attack 36% differ from Korean/Chinese 30%; cap interpretation of speed-scaled debuffs also differs. These contested effects are excluded.
Dizzy/Shock accuracy and immunities; dynamic flat Attack conversion from live game stats to normalized simulator stats.

comparison.existingEngineLogic: No dedicated identifier or named skill branch found for this character; generic resolveSkill is integration point, no extraction needed.

skill1.name: Discharge Sprocket
skill1.description:
Deal Electric damage to all foes equal to 101.7%/112.1%/108.0%/118.4% of Attack, and inflict Hard Knocks for 3 turns. When in Lightning Legs state, also increase this skill's damage by 35%.
Also, Secret Technique: Lightning Legs can be used 1 time.
Hard Knocks: Decrease Defense by 9.8%/10.8%/10.4%/11.4% (for every 10 points of Speed, increase by 2.22% more, up to a maximum of 39.0%/43.0%/41.4%/45.4%). Also, increase damage taken by 7.8%/8.6%/8.3%/9.1% (for every 10 points of Speed, increase by 1.78% more, up to a maximum of 31.2%/34.4%/33.2%/36.4%).

skill2.name: Thunderbolt Outrage
skill2.description:
Deal Electric damage to all foes equal to 135.5%/149.3%/143.8%/157.7% of Attack. Decrease Down Points of all targets that take damage by 1 regardless of Electric affinity, and inflict Hard Knocks for 1 turn. When in Lightning Legs state, decrease Down Points of all targets that take damage by 3 more and inflict Detention for 1 turn.
Hard Knocks: Decrease Defense by 9.8%/10.8%/10.4%/11.4% (for every 10 points of Katayama's Speed, increase by 2.22% more, up to a maximum of 39.0%/43.0%/41.4%/45.4%). Also, increase damage taken by 7.8%/8.6%/8.3%/9.1% (for every 10 points of Katayama's Speed, increase by 1.78% more, up to a maximum of 31.2%/34.4%/33.2%/36.4%).
Detention: Increase damage taken while knocked down by 0.56% for every 10 points of Katayama's Speed (up to a maximum of 9.8%/10.8%/10.4%/11.4%). Also, increase damage taken by 6.8%/7.5%/7.3%/8.0% (for every 10 points of Katayama's Speed, increase by 1.55% more, up to a maximum of 27.3%/30.1%/29.0%/31.8%).

skill3.name: Secret Technique: Lightning Legs
skill3.description:
Deal Electric damage to all foes equal to 141.9%/156.5%/150.6%/165.2% of Attack. When targets take damage, decrease Down Points by 5 regardless of Electric affinity, and inflict Detention for 1 turn.
When this skill knocks down any target, gain Lightning Legs for 2 turns.
Detention: Increase damage taken while knocked down by 0.56% for every 10 points of Katayama's Speed (up to a maximum of 9.8%/10.8%/10.4%/11.4%). Also, increase damage taken by 6.8%/7.5%/7.3%/8.0% (for every 10 points of Speed, increase by 1.55% more, up to a maximum of 27.3%/30.1%/29.0%/31.8%).
Lightning Legs: Enhance the skill effects of the next Discharge Sprocket or Thunderbolt Outrage used.

skill_highlight.name: Highlight
skill_highlight.description: Deal Electric damage to all foes equal to 317.6%/350.1%/337.1%/369.7% of Attack, and 50% chance to inflict Dizzy on foes for 1 turn. Also, permanently decrease the target's Defense by 29.3%/32.3%/31.1%/34.1% (this effect does not stack). Also, increase damage taken by 19.5%/21.5%/20.7%/22.7% for 3 turns.

passive1.name: Answer the Call
passive1.description: When an ally attacks a knocked down foe, increase Attack by 36.0%.

passive2.name: High-Speed Vector
passive2.description: During battle, when Katayama's Speed is above 100, increase Attack by 24 for every 1 point of Speed above 100 (up to 1920).

ritual.name: Kumi Katayama
ritual.r0_detail:
When Katayama uses Discharge Sprocket, Secret Technique: Lightning Legs is unlocked and becomes usable 1 time.
When Secret Technique: Lightning Legs deals damage, greatly decrease the target's Down Points regardless of Electric affinity. Also, increase the Defense decrease effect of Hard Knocks by 10% for 2 turns (for every 10 points of Speed, increase by 2.22% more, up to a maximum bonus of 40%).
ritual.r1_detail:
When Katayama knocks down a foe, permanently decrease the target's Down Point maximum by 1.
When a target is inflicted with Detention, increase critical damage taken by 30% more for 1 turn.
When Katayama deals Electric damage, inflict Shock on the target.
ritual.r2_detail: When Katayama knocks down a foe with a skill, increase the target's damage taken while downed by 10% more for 1 turn. Also, permanently increase party's Attack by 10% (stacks up to 3 times).
ritual.r3_detail: Increase the skill levels of Discharge Sprocket and Thunderbolt Outrage by 3.
ritual.r4_detail: Highlight Enhanced: After activating a Highlight, the next time Katayama knocks down a foe, permanently increase the target's damage taken by 20% more. This effect does not stack.
ritual.r5_detail: Increase the skill levels of Secret Technique: Lightning Legs and Thief Tactics by 3.
ritual.r6_detail:
At the start of battle, gain 2 Wings of Guidance stacks. Gain 1 Wings of Guidance stack after every 2 skills used. Wings of Guidance stacks up to 3 times.
At the start of Katayama's turn, spend 1 Wings of Guidance stack to gain the following buffs for 1 turn. Increase Katayama's Attack by 50%, critical rate by 10%, critical damage by 30%, and allow her Highlight to activate critical hits. Also, increase damage taken by foes with Hard Knocks by 30% more, and increase damage taken by downed foes with Detention by 20% more.
When Katayama takes fatal damage, if she has Wings of Guidance, spend 1 Wings of Guidance stack to evade that damage (this effect activates once per battle, and is not effective against certain skills).

weapon3-1.name: Combat Boots
weapon3-1.description: When user has [Super Limit], increase Speed by 7.4/8.5/9.6/10.7/11.8/12.9/14.0.

weapon4-1.name: Blitzkrieg Bangs
weapon4-1.description:
Increase Attack by 12.0%/12.0%/16.0%/16.0%/20.0%/20.0%/24.0%.
When Katayama knocks down foes, increase Attack by 7.5%/9.8%/9.8%/12.0%/12.0%/14.2%/14.2% for each foe knocked down (up to a maximum of 22.5%/29.2%/29.2%/36.0%/36.0%/42.7%/42.7%). Lasts for 1 turn.

weapon5-1.name: Lightning Riders
weapon5-1.description:
Increase Speed by 15.0/15.0/20.0/20.0/25.0/25.0/30.0.
After using Secret Technique: Lightning Legs, increase Katayama's critical rate by 9.0%/11.7%/11.7%/14.3%/14.3%/17.0%/17.0% for 2 turns.
If any foes are knocked down when Katayama is present, increase the target's critical damage taken by 30.6%/39.8%/39.8%/49.0%/49.0%/58.2%/58.2% for 1 turn.

integration.initialize: After live party stats/buffs initialized, once per assigned unit.
integration.beforeSkill: resolveSkill entry before cost/damage; replace skill with return value. Only dispatch for owning actor. Exceptions block unsupported casts before costs.
integration.afterSkill: Once after own resolved skill, passing returned prepared skill. Never invoke for preview or rejected action.
integration.onTurnStart: After characterTurnsStarted increments; owning unit only.
integration.adapter: Call adaptCharacterDefinition on live record before legal actions are built; preserves IDs and sets source-aware targets. Respect characterUnavailable in legal-action listing.
integration.options: engine.config.characterOptions[slug]: sourceTier (0..3), weapon, refinement (0..6), staticWeaponStatsIncluded, flatAttackScale (Luce only, explicit live-flat to simulation-flat conversion).
